name: incident.io
description: Incidents, their timeline and follow-ups in incident.io.
long_description:
incident.io's hosted server. It reads incidents with their timeline, severities and follow-ups, and can update one.

An incident is something a team is watching in real time, so anything that writes to one is confirmed.

auth.instructions: Sign in to incident.io in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your incidents. Updating one is visible to everybody watching the incident channel.
